title: MuseCritic: Learning Multi-Aspect Song Rewards through Natural-Language Aesthetic Critiques
abstract: arXiv:2608.11755v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-form song generation models continue to improve in duration, structural integrity, and acoustic complexity, making reliable aesthetic rewards increasingly important for aligning these models with human preferences. However, reward models for complete songs remain limited, and existing evaluators typically predict scores in a single forward pass without providing readable explanations. We introduce MUSECRITIC, a semi-scalar reward model that generates a natural-language critique covering five aesthetic dimensions and uses it as an intermediate representation to predict continuous reward scores. MUSECRITIC follows a two-stage training pipeline: a teacher model first provides high-quality critiques for supervised fine-tuning, after which the fine-tuned model generates its own critiques for reward learning, mitigating distribution shift between training and inference. translated_title: MuseCritic：通过自然语言美学评论学习多维度歌曲奖励
translated_abstract: 长篇歌曲生成模型在时长、结构完整性和声学复杂度方面持续改进，使得可靠的美学奖励对于将这些模型与人类偏好对齐变得越来越重要。然而，针对完整歌曲的奖励模型仍然有限，现有评估器通常通过单次前向传递预测分数，而不提供可读的解释。我们引入了MUSECRITIC，一种半标量奖励模型，它生成涵盖五个美学维度的自然语言评论，并将其作为中间表示来预测连续的奖励分数。MUSECRITIC遵循两阶段训练流程：首先，教师模型提供高质量评论用于监督微调，随后微调模型生成自己的评论用于奖励学习，从而缓解训练与推理之间的分布偏移。在包含200首SongEval歌曲的领域内测试集上，MUSECRITIC减少了...
tldr: MUSECRITIC通过生成自然语言美学评论作为中间表示来预测歌曲奖励分数，采用两阶段训练流程，有效提升了多维度歌曲评估的准确性和可解释性。
en_tdlr: MUSECRITIC predicts song reward scores by generating natural-language aesthetic critiques as intermediate representations, using a two-stage training pipeline to enhance multi-aspect song evaluation accuracy and interpretability.
